mapper.select: SELECT WAREHOUSE_ID AS warehouseId, ITEM_ID AS itemId, QUANTITY AS quantity, TO_CHAR( UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS updatedAt FROM STOCK ORDER BY WAREHOUSE_ID, ITEM_ID

SELECT WAREHOUSE_ID AS warehouseId, ITEM_ID AS itemId, QUANTITY AS quantity, TO_CHAR( UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS updatedAt FROM STOCK WHERE WAREHOUSE_ID = #{warehouseId} AND ITEM_ID = #{itemId}

SELECT WAREHOUSE_ID AS warehouseId, WAREHOUSE_CODE AS warehouseCode, WAREHOUSE_NAME AS warehouseName, WAREHOUSE_TYPE AS warehouseType, ACTIVE_FLAG AS activeFlag FROM WAREHOUSE WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY WAREHOUSE_CODE, WAREHOUSE_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STOCK ( WAREHOUSE_ID, ITEM_ID, QUANTITY, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{warehouseId}, #{itemId}, #{quantity}, LOCALTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO STOCK_MOVEMENT ( MOVEMENT_ID, SALE_ID, SALE_LINE_ID, WAREHOUSE_ID, ITEM_ID, QUANTITY_DELTA, OCCURRED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_STOCK_MOVEMENT.NEXTVAL, NULL, NULL, #{warehouseId}, #{itemId}, #{quantityDelta}, LOCALTIMESTAMP )
